// diagnostic E1023

Jet.UnknownLibraryMarker

No imported module declares this qualified marker.

What

No imported module declares this qualified marker.

Why

A qualified marker names a marker that the module behind its import declares.

Fix

Check the marker's spelling and the import's local name, or declare the marker in that module.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnknownLibraryMarker: Tests/UI/QualifiedMarkerUnknown/stderr.
